query: WITH desired AS (SELECT id, provider_id, alias_name, regexp_replace(lower(trim(alias_name)), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') AS desired_normalized FROM public.provider_name_aliases WHERE source = 'workbook_import') SELECT desired_normalized, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT provider_id) AS provider_count FROM desired GROUP BY desired_normalized HAVING count(*) > 1 OR count(DISTINCT provider_id) > 1 ORDER BY row_count DESC LIMIT 50; WITH desired AS (SELECT id, provider_id, alias_name, regexp_replace(lower(trim(alias_name)), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') AS desired_normalized FROM public.provider_name_aliases WHERE source = 'workbook_import') SELECT d.alias_name, d.provider_id, a.source, a.alias_name AS existing_alias_name, a.provider_id AS existing_provider_id FROM desired d JOIN public.provider_name_aliases a ON a.normalized_alias = d.desired_normalized AND a.id <> d.id WHERE a.provider_id <> d.provider_id LIMIT 50
